howItWorks.intro: Five moves from download to a clean export. No rig, no second person, no editing degree required.
howItWorks.title: How It Works
howItWorks.step1Desc: Download Movtrak on the App Store to start your 7-day full access trial.
howItWorks.step2Desc: Position the camera towards yourself or the activity.
howItWorks.step3Desc: Tap record — AI automatically detects and centres you.
howItWorks.step4Desc: Go ahead. The camera follows your movement.
howItWorks.step5Desc: Stop recording and export your perfectly framed video.
